purpose: Assess first-party official routes for the H1 direct-A-share data contract and distinguish public page/document access from written data-use, retention, derived-analysis, replay and independent-review rights. This is not a data delivery, data acceptance, replay, investment conclusion or execution instruction.

required_domains: data-use, retention, replay and independent-review rights
providers_reviewed: Shenzhen Stock Exchange / Shenzhen Securities Information

method_and_boundary.source_capture_boundary: P06 retains five official route/service/website-terms pages after the route assessment. It contains no historical data delivery, contract, entitlement, point-in-time archive or execution record.
method_and_boundary.allowed_inference: A first-party page may establish that an official disclosure, product, authorization or application route exists and may state a narrow product or use condition.
prohibited_inference: Public access proves complete historical coverage.
An announcement timestamp or page date proves model available_at semantics.
A web route proves an executed license, eligibility, retention, normalization, derived-analysis, replay or independent-review rights.
A local field sample proves all-universe coverage, no revisions, event completeness or formal replay readiness.

access_degradation.observation: The execution environment returned 403 Forbidden for a direct request and the browser experienced a redirect loop.
access_degradation.treatment: Record the official route and the first-party search-indexed route description only; do not claim field-level verification or contract terms.

access_degradation.route: CNINFO Data Service and some SZSE dynamic pages
access_degradation.observation: The routes are JavaScript/login based or timed out in the browser.
access_degradation.treatment: Treat them as inquiry routes, not as verified API documentation, delivery or entitlement.

source_routes.title: SSE Market Data Products — Historical Data
source_routes.dataset_delivery_status: subscription route described; no delivery received
observed_facts: The page says historical data covers Shanghai A shares, Shanghai B shares and indices.
It lists Level-1 historical data, Level-2 intraday snapshot history, historical tick data and historical order-book data among its content descriptions.
It states an earliest available date of 1990-12-19, daily issue basis, yearly subscription basis and CSV format.
It states only qualified vendors are authorized to redistribute or use the stated real-time Level-1 and Level-2 data.
possible_h1_use_if_entitled: Shanghai-venue price, volume, tick and selected order-book history inquiry.
A possible procurement route for a portion of historical trade-state inputs.
not_established: All-venue or all-security historical universe, including delisted objects and decision-date status.
Financial-statement line items, corporate-action ledger, source-side available_at, revision chain or coverage reconciliation.
This case's executed entitlement to retain, normalize, derive, replay or submit data to independent review.

source_routes.title: SSE Market-data service / authorization and application route
source_routes.dataset_delivery_status: application route described; no application or contract obtained
observed_facts: The page directs market institutions to product descriptions, authorization licenses, fee schedules and business documents, and says applications can be handled through the business platform.
possible_h1_use_if_entitled: Request a precise historical dataset specification and contractual use rights from the official data-service channel.
not_established: Applicant qualification.
Data package coverage, historical status fields, delivery manifest or contract rights.

source_routes.title: SSE website legal statement
observed_facts: The page states that website-content rights remain with SSE, permits non-commercial browsing/download subject to the statement, and restricts profit-oriented use without written permission.
not_established: Retention or reproducible archival rights from public web access.
Any exception for normalized historical replay or independent review.

source_routes.title: SZSE company market-data and historical XBRL routes
source_routes.dataset_delivery_status: public-page route only; no historical delivery received
observed_facts: The market-data route lists listed companies, stock lists, basic indicators, rankings and name changes.

The historical XBRL notice states that the platform then offered standardized report data query/display for all 740 Shenzhen-listed companies for 2004–2008, with analysis, comparison and download functions.
possible_h1_use_if_entitled: Investigate Shenzhen issuer identity/disclosure routes and whether a current structured financial product provides a full PIT delivery.
not_established: A complete continuous all-A-share financial history.
All listed/delisted Shenzhen objects, document versions, source available_at or restatement lineage.
Any current contractual replay entitlement.

source_routes.title: SZSE legal statement
observed_facts: The statement says intellectual-property rights in website materials, including market quotes, listed-company information and market statistics, belong to SZSE unless otherwise provided by law or agreement.

It permits non-commercial browsing/download subject to the statement, but says that without SZSE written permission, for-profit use may not include copying, downloading, storage, scraping, conversion, reproduction or dissemination.
not_established: Long-term archival, normalized-data, derived-analysis, replay or independent-review rights for this case.

source_routes.provider: Shenzhen Stock Exchange / Shenzhen Securities Information
source_routes.title: SZSE market-data authorization and enhanced-market-data application route
source_routes.dataset_delivery_status: authorization/application route described; no contract received
observed_facts: SZSE lists Shenzhen Securities Information as its market-data authorization contact.

The enhanced-market-data guidance describes self-use/non-display authorization, application, acceptance and contract-signing steps, and identifies specified institutional applicant classes for non-display self-use.
possible_h1_use_if_entitled: Ask the first-party provider for historical Shenzhen market-data scope, data dictionary and license terms.
not_established: The case applicant's eligibility.
Historical coverage, PIT financials, corporate-action scope or rights for archive/replay/independent review.

source_routes.title: BSE stock list, quotation and statistics routes
source_routes.public_page_access: public route, but direct request blocked in this execution environment
observed_facts: The official routes are titled Stock List, Stock Quotation and Stock Statistics and are market-data discovery routes.
possible_h1_use_if_entitled: Ask BSE for historical universe and trade-state delivery specifications.
not_established: Field-level query output in this run.
Complete historical security lifecycle, PIT financials, corporate actions, no-trade state or replay rights.

source_routes.title: BSE domestic market-data authorization / Level-1 application process
source_routes.dataset_delivery_status: application, review, agreement and license-issuance route described; no agreement obtained
observed_facts: The official guide and its Level-1 process attachment describe an application workflow that includes review, agreement signing and issuance of a license-use agreement.
possible_h1_use_if_entitled: Obtain a BSE-specific written proposal for historical scope and applicable data-use rights.
not_established: Historical product scope, complete-universe coverage, field dictionary, storage, derived-analysis, replay, audit and post-termination retention rights.

source_routes.title: CNINFO public disclosure portal
source_routes.dataset_delivery_status: public disclosure/document route; no bulk delivery received
observed_facts: The portal presents announcement categories for Shenzhen, Shanghai and Beijing markets, as well as periodic reports, historical dividends, share-capital/lock-up, termination/delisting, issuance and other disclosure discovery categories.
The portal states it is operated by Shenzhen Securities Information, a wholly owned subsidiary of SZSE, and carries a disclaimer that it does not guarantee accuracy or completeness.
possible_h1_use_if_entitled: Find original issuer disclosure documents and investigate corporate-action/financial data product coverage.
not_established: A comprehensive structured PIT financial or corporate-action delivery.
Source-side available_at, version/revision history, coverage reconciliation or data-use/replay rights.

source_routes.title: CNINFO Data Service
source_routes.public_page_access: landing page visible; data service is JavaScript/login based
source_routes.dataset_delivery_status: data-market/API route visible; no API documentation, entitlement or delivery received
observed_facts: The platform route presents data services, data market, API documentation/help, data browser, financial analysis, announcement information and market-data sections.
possible_h1_use_if_entitled: Request a cross-market data catalogue and a contract explicitly covering H1 historical financial and event inputs.
not_established: Product fields, historical start/end dates, all-venue/delisted coverage, available_at/revision semantics or contractual replay rights.

source_routes.title: CSRC notice on designated ChiNext disclosure websites
observed_facts: The notice identifies CNINFO as an SZSE-affiliated designated disclosure website for ChiNext and says designated sites would freely publish prospectuses, listing announcements, ad hoc announcements, periodic reports and relevant CSRC/SZSE rules.
possible_h1_use_if_entitled: Establish CNINFO's authority as a disclosure route for the stated segment.
not_established: A cross-market historical data license, database entitlement, record-retention right, replay right or independent-review right.

h1_gate_assessment.official_route_observed: SSE historical-data subscription route; SZSE/BSE public list/quotation and authorization routes.
missing_for_acceptance: All SH/SZ/BJ securities with unique identity and lifecycle, including delisted/transferred/suspended/special-status/no-trade records.
Decision-date state, source-side available_at, revisions, coverage reconciliation and immutable delivery manifest.

h1_gate_assessment.official_route_observed: CNINFO/venue disclosures and CNINFO Data Service are inquiry routes; SZSE historical XBRL notice demonstrates limited historical structured-report functionality.
missing_for_acceptance: Complete-population structured line items with accounting definitions and source-document hashes.
First-publication available_at, amendments/restatements/withdrawals, field-level version lineage and written rights.

h1_gate_assessment.official_route_observed: Existing R2 SSE samples show local dividend, bonus and suspension fields; CNINFO provides disclosure/category discovery; SSE product description includes historical trading-data categories.
missing_for_acceptance: Complete cross-venue event taxonomy and effective-dated ledger for distributions, rights, splits, mergers, restructurings, delistings, suspensions, price limits, special treatment and no-trade states.
Event versions, source available_at, price-adjustment method and population/event coverage reconciliation.

h1_gate_assessment.official_route_observed: SSE historical product and SZSE/BSE authorization routes provide possible venue-level market-data procurement paths.
missing_for_acceptance: Full SH/SZ/BJ historical delivery and security/date field dictionary.
Trading eligibility, depth/capacity or frozen conservative proxy, order/fill/no-fill and settlement evidence.

h1_gate_assessment.official_route_observed: SSE, SZSE and BSE show authorization or agreement mechanisms; public SSE/SZSE terms reserve rights or constrain public-page reproduction/storage.
missing_for_acceptance: Executed provider-by-provider written agreement naming dataset ID, historical scope, delivery, retention, normalization, derived analysis, replay, audit/independent review, confidentiality, duration and post-termination archive treatment.
Delivery manifest, file hashes, version/revision policy and a coverage reconciliation.

h1_gate_assessment.official_route_observed: No exchange, CNINFO or CSRC route reviewed supplies the necessary account-specific historical broker route, fee, tax, fill/no-fill and settlement ledger.
missing_for_acceptance: Effective-dated broker/clearing terms, account permissions, fill/no-fill evidence, fees, taxes, settlement and failure-state ledger, plus applicable rights.

formal_replay_conclusion.reason: The reviewed first-party pages establish useful procurement/disclosure/authorization routes but do not supply a complete SH/SZ/BJ PIT universe, PIT financials, full corporate-action and trade-state ledger, delivery lineage, written data rights, or execution/cost/settlement evidence.
formal_replay_conclusion.specific_sse_limitation: Even an eventual SSE historical market-data delivery would be Shanghai-venue scoped and would not by itself supply Shenzhen/Beijing population, PIT financials, complete events, rights or broker execution evidence.

minimum_next_request_package.request: Executed data contract or signed entitlement letter explicitly granting raw and normalized retention, derived analysis, historical replay, freeze, audit and independent-review rights, with dataset IDs, scope, duration and post-termination treatment.

minimum_next_request_package.required_from: SSE, SZSE and BSE or a first-party-authorized cross-venue provider with explicit authority
minimum_next_request_package.request: Historical master and every-decision-date state for all listed, delisted, transferred, suspended, special-status and no-trade objects, with unique identifiers, coverage reconciliation and hashes.

minimum_next_request_package.required_from: CNINFO/SZSE/SSE/BSE disclosure-data provider with explicit authority
minimum_next_request_package.request: Original reports and standardized field-level financials for the complete population, including available_at, initial/amended/restated/withdrawn versions, source hashes, accounting definitions and missing-data rules.

Complete effective-dated corporate-action and trading-status ledger, including distributions, capital actions, restructuring/delisting treatment, suspensions, price limits, special treatment and no-trade state, plus version and adjustment methodology.

minimum_next_request_package.required_from: Applicable broker, clearing and rule/cost providers
minimum_next_request_package.request: Effective-dated fees/taxes, account-route permissions, conservative execution/depth policy or source data, fills/no-fills, settlement and failure records with retention/replay/audit rights.
Immutable delivery manifest, hashes, coverage-gap reconciliation, available_at/version tests and acceptance under DPSFS-DAC-v12 before any protocol freeze under DPSFS-RP0-v10.

decision_boundary.allowed_next_step: Primary-source entitlement inquiry and data-contract design only.
